newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares at new highs, Hansapank.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares at new highs, Hansapank.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian stock exchange stayed buoyant, sending the index up 4.49 percent to 196.89 and giving record turnover of 79.3 million kroons.
But most share prices closed lower than the highs reached during the day, leading some to speculate that the recent rally may be nearing its end.
"There is not much room for the prices to rise further," one dealer said, adding that a market correction may occur tomorrow.
Market leader Hansapank was the most traded on turnover of 26.5 million kroons and closed at 184.50, up 3.5 kroons.
Hansapank's shares had reached a 191 kroons high during the day's trade.
All shares still made gains versus Wednesday's close.
Estonian Savings Bank rose, registering volume of 22.4 million kroons. It closed one kroon up at 87.5 kroons.
Union Bank moved up to close 0.5 kroon higher at 45.35 on activity of 11.2 million kroons.
Tallinna Pank gained 0.60 kroons to 72.05 with shares worth 8.4 million traded and Forekspank picked up 2.75 kroons to end the day at 144.75 turning over 5.1 million kroons.
The over-the-counter-market was strong with plastics manufacturer Norma registering business of 4.4 million kroons. It closed 4.9 kroons up at 58.9 kroons.
Rakvere meat plant also gained 0.70 kroons to 14.85 on volume of 3.9 million kroons.
The total volume of the free market was some 14 million kroons.
